title: Egypt Concludes 'Badr 2026' Sinai Exercise; PLA Observers Signal China Defense Shift
detail: Egypt concluded its 'Badr 2026' live-fire military exercise in Sinai on April 30, involving Air Force, Air Defense, Armored Corps, and Special Forces units under Defense Minister Ashraf Salem Zaher. Chinese PLA military observers closely monitored the five-day exercise amid ongoing Egypt-China negotiations covering advanced fighter jets, Type 039A submarines, and Chinese air defense systems. The exercise highlights Egypt's deliberate military diversification away from exclusive US dependency — paralleling Cairo's broader 'Partners with Conditions' foreign policy posture of maintaining US aid while deepening ties with Beijing.
